description: Keymap & shortcuts: Tab / Shift+Tab in input mode cycle voice forward / backward. Outside input mode Tab keeps normal focus behaviour. Escape leaves input mode. No Ctrl+Alt+digit shortcuts.
testName: Tab in input mode is mapped and default-prevented; Tab outside input mode is NOT default-prevented

description: Pure cursor functions: Cursor = { staffId, voiceIndex, measureId, tick }. Voice switching changes cursor only: never creates, never deletes, never modifies events or voices, never creates an undo entry. Invariant: tick is always at the START of a sounding event in that voice (or the barline); switching voices snaps to the start of the event sounding at the old tick, NEVER forward into silence or the next event. If the voice does not exist in that measure, cursor stays at the same tick (virtual cursor).

Voice creation on entry: First entry into a missing voice creates the voice in that measure in the SAME undo step: rests fill [0, t) via fillMeasureWithRests, then the entered event, then rests to the barline. Voices stay sorted by voiceIndex; gaps are allowed (voices 1 and 3 without 2).
testName: T2: entry in missing voice 2 at tick 1920 of an empty 4/4 measure gives rests for [0, 1920) + the note + rests to the barline, total 3840; validateScore zero errors; voices sorted

description: Entry into existing voice: Reuses the existing entry path with voiceIndex.
testName: inserts notes in voice 2 addressed by voiceIndex and leaves voice 1 untouched

description: Cursor advance after entry: Advances in the same voice, never dropping to voice 1; crossing barlines keeps voiceIndex (virtual if the target measure lacks that voice).
testName: verifies 20 seeds x 200 steps of random voice navigation, entry, and undo/redo

description: Status bar voice indicator: Shows 'Ses {N}' (tr) / 'Voice {N}' (en) in input mode, with data-testid='status-voice-indicator', reactive to cursor.voiceIndex.

description: Undo/Redo cursor restoration: Undo and redo restore the exact cursor state (including voiceIndex).
